questions.question: Tell me about a production incident you handled.
questions.tip: Show calm triage, communication, the fix and the follow-up that stopped it recurring.

questions.question: Tell me about a mistake you made.
questions.tip: Own it plainly, show the fix, and what you changed so nobody repeats it.

questions.question: Tell me about a disagreement with a colleague and how you resolved it.
questions.tip: Disagree on the idea, not the person; show data and the outcome you both accepted.

questions.question: Describe a time you delivered under a tight deadline.
questions.tip: What you cut, what you protected (quality, safety), and how you kept people informed.

questions.question: Tell me about a process you automated or improved.
questions.tip: Before and after numbers: time saved, errors removed, people unblocked.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you led without formal authority.
questions.tip: How you got buy-in: a pilot, data, listening to objections.

questions.question: Tell me about something you had to learn quickly.
questions.tip: How you learned (docs, labs, experts) and how you proved you'd got it.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you went beyond your role.
questions.tip: Why it mattered to the business, and how you avoided stepping on toes.

questions.question: Tell me about a difficult stakeholder.
questions.tip: Understand their goal, set expectations, show progress early.

questions.question: How did you prioritise when everything was urgent?
questions.tip: A clear rule (impact, risk, deadlines), saying no or not-yet, and agreement from the people affected.

questions.question: Tell me about feedback you received and acted on.
questions.tip: Specific feedback, what you changed, and the evidence it worked.

questions.question: Tell me how you got a team to adopt a new tool or practice.
questions.tip: Start small, measure, make the new way the easy way.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you found a security risk.
questions.tip: How you found it, how you assessed severity, and the fix plus the guardrail added.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you reduced cloud cost.
questions.tip: The number saved, how you found the waste, and how you kept it from coming back.

questions.question: Describe a project with unclear requirements.
questions.tip: Questions you asked, assumptions you wrote down, and how you iterated.

questions.question: Tell me about helping a teammate grow.
questions.tip: What they could do afterwards that they could not before.

questions.question: Tell me about a technical decision you would make differently now.
questions.tip: The context at the time, what you learned, and what you'd do now.

questions.question: Tell me about a large migration you were part of.
questions.tip: Planning, waves, rollback, and how you kept users unaffected.

questions.question: What achievement are you most proud of?
questions.tip: Your part (I, not we), the impact in numbers, and why it mattered.

questions.question: Tell me about a change you made that broke something.
questions.tip: Detection, rollback, communication, and the pipeline or test you added afterwards.
